static_traits.name: Mark
static_traits.occupation: 资深跑者/马拉松爱好者
static_traits.social_status: 有一群支持性的朋友与跑步伙伴，但not yet主动分享自己的not足与自卑感受
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness；without既往心理治疗或类似心理问题史
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰，但常use消极标签（如“失败者”）、灾难化与非黑即白的措辞，并倾向过滤正面信息

basic_info.main_problem: 与马拉松成绩相关的自我not足感和自我批评，赛后持续怀疑能力、将自己贴上“失败者”的标签，并过滤掉以往的积极跑步成就。
basic_info.core_demands: 这些Self-doubt和not足感正在影响我参加not yet来马拉松比赛的动力。
growth_experiences: 六个月前的马拉松比赛中，给自己设定“前三名”的高期待但not yet达成；赛后持续反复思考表现、怀疑能力、以“失败者”自我标签进行贬损，并将过去的Good完赛与训练成绩视为“not重要”；这种体验伴随压力与羞耻，导致训练Decreased drive与回避跑步群体。

special_situations.event: 想到要参加下一场马拉松
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能拿到前三或获胜，就说明我not配被认可，是个失败者
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 通过自我施压和积极自我对话来试图提升表现，但当Anxiety升高时转为回避训练
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我又会失败，I am not good enough

special_situations.event: 回忆上一次马拉松的失利
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 一次失败就能证明我整体能力not足，过去的努力都not算数
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 反复Reflection并negate正面证据，Reinforcement自我批评以“逼迫自己进步”
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我所有的努力都白费了

special_situations.event: 与跑友见面或准备参加跑团活动
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我表现not好，do not人就会看not起我，我会被视为失败者
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids contact with running partners to reduce the risk of being evaluated
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们会觉得我not行、I am a failure

special_situations.event: 看到他人的比赛排名或成绩分享
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 必须比do not人更好才算有价值，只要not如对方就是失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Focuses goals on rankings and winning or losing, ignoring the process and personal progress
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not as good as others，所以我就是失败者

core_conflict.wish: Longs to prove self-worth through excellent performance and rankings, gaining others' recognition and respect
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败后被视为without能与“失败者”，遭遇羞耻与negate，失去自我价值感
defense_goal: 以严苛的自我要求与自我批评来避免再次失败与外界negate
Maintains fragile self-esteem and security by avoiding running groups and others' evaluations

object_relations.self_representation: not足、需要通过成绩证明自己的竞争者/被评价者
object_relations.object_representation: Harsh judges / more accomplished others (running friends/groups)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about running partners or race rankings and performance comparisons
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 来访者倾向认为他人会看not起自己、将自己视为失败者（移情：将内在的Self-denialProjection到他人的眼光）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 采用温和澄清的语气，邀请具体证据与替代解释；避免直接反驳，use开放式Questioning与Empathy反映，帮助其区分事实与猜测。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When recalling the last competition loss and feeling intense shame
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将对外的愤怒与挫败Turning against the self，Reinforcement“失败者”的自我标签
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以接纳且not评判的语气识do not自我攻击的语言，use温柔的重构与情感命名，鼓励将能量转向具体、可行的训练目标与过程价值。

manifestations: 跑步曾带来Freedom与清晰，但因一次失利而被胜负与名次完全定义
Believes the efforts were 'all in vain', downplaying past progress and accomplishments
outcomes: 回避参与跑团与跑步活动

manifestations: 有支持性朋友却not yet分享真实的not足与羞耻感受
因自我评价而回避跑团

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Internalizes the external rule 'must be top three / must win to count as good' as a standard of self-worth
Judges himself by the single indicator of ranking and winning/losing, ignoring process and personal progress

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'.
manifestations: When invited to focus on the positive side and process value, quickly returns to the failure narrative
Avoids talking about own true feelings when communicating with running friends

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: 假设他人会看not起自己、把自己视为失败者
In social scenes, presumes negative evaluation and thus chooses avoidance

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 以过高标准约束自我，导致训练Decreased drive与回避

exception_events.target_problem: 在谈到跑步或想到参加下一场马拉松时，来访者通常会Self-denial、与他人比较并感到羞耻，从而减少训练并回避跑团。
exception_events.unique_outcome: 与朋友交流他们的跑步经历时，曾短暂地not进行自我比较，能够欣赏他人的成就并体验到一些轻松与认可感，负面自评减弱。
exception_events.reason: Clue: in a setting where attention was on others' experiences and the perspective shifted toward appreciation and sharing, self-comparison and labeling were temporarily interrupted; the group support atmosphere and focus on the present moment reduced the fixation on rankings.

positive_force: 拥有支持性的朋友与跑步社群
过往多次Good训练与马拉松完赛记录（具备稳定的跑步基础）
Able to try self-encouragement and positive self-talk
清楚知道跑步带来的Freedom感与身心愉悦（内在动机基础）
negative_force: 灾难化与非黑即白的思维模式
negate正面/心理过滤，持续忽略进步与过程价值
Strict external performance standards and self-labeling ('failure')
Shame and assumptions of others' negative evaluations lead to avoiding training and socializing

target_behavior.behavior: 回避跑步训练与跑团活动
antecedent: 想到参加下一场马拉松
看到他人分享成绩或排名
target_behavior.core_reason: 内化“必须获胜/进入前三才算好”的僵化标准，灾难化Anticipation再次失败并被他人negate，引发羞耻与Anxiety。
target_behavior.function: Avoiding the negative emotions associated with being evaluated and failing, maintaining self-esteem and a sense of safety in the short term.
target_behavior.consequence: 训练Decreased drive，身体活动与自我照护减少，进一步ReinforcementSelf-denial与失败感。

target_behavior.behavior: Excessive self-criticism and labeling (defining oneself as a 'failure')
antecedent: When talking with others about running or seeing others' results
思考设定训练目标与名次要求时
target_behavior.core_reason: Takes external rankings and win-loss standards as the sole basis of self-worth, ignoring process and multidimensional performance, and thus attributes setbacks to the whole self
target_behavior.function: Gains a temporary sense of control and 'spurring' through self-punishment and self-reproach, trying to avoid failing again.
target_behavior.consequence: Low mood与动力受损，训练与Social avoidance加重，生活与自我照料下降。
